method: Alternate anatomical UV meshes, bound at the illustrated pose, with one permanent rigid staff. No whole-image crossfading.

motion.interpolation: Bounded vector cubic Hermite for body/grip paths; monotone angular and support channels. Shared tangents across waypoints, zero tangents at endpoints and true holds.
motion.source_pixels: Unchanged v8 images; hash-checked Mi-Ripple provenance.
